source: Fictional housing cooperative (bostadsrättsförening) board meeting written for Task Q (scripts/notes-eval.ts). Fictional association and people; no real meeting.
traps: Fee increase proposed as 5 %, changed to 3 % before it is decided.
Washing machine: a 35 000 kr professional model is discussed, the 28 000 kr model is decided.
Charging posts (laddstolpar) are explicitly NOT decided; tabled to the next board meeting (allowed only as a deferral).
Ahmed may ask his brother-in-law about charging boxes, 'men jag lovar ingenting' (not an action).
The broken door phone is already reported, and the laundry-room sign is already up (no actions).
Eva typed the action 'book the party room for the annual meeting' into the notes tab herself before the meeting; it must not be duplicated.
Amounts said in words (tjugoåttatusen, tre procent).

human_lines.line: ☐ Eva Lind: Boka festlokalen till föreningsstämman (senast 15 mars)

decisions.text: Målningen av trapphusen skjuts upp ett år.
Den enklare tvättmaskinen köps för högst 28 000 kr inkl. installation.

action_items.text: Sätta upp lappar i trapphusen om avgiftshöjningen
Lägga in den nya avgiften i aviseringen
Begära in två offerter på laddstolpar

must_not.text: The 5 % proposal recorded as a decision
The 35 000 kr machine recorded as a decision
A decision on charging posts (only a deferral to the next meeting is allowed)
Ahmed's 'lovar ingenting' about charging boxes as an action
Door phone (already reported) as an action
Duplicate of the human-typed line (party room for the annual meeting)
